24/G.goal: Explain how XR systems function as interactive systems and how user characteristics, user-centered design methods, and usability criteria guide their input interaction and output perception design.
24/G.achieves: It gives the learner a foundational understanding of XR as interactive systems and user-centered design, preparing them to address human factors and build XR systems confidently.

24/O1.goal: Explain how user characteristics, user-centered design methods, and usability criteria guide the design and development of interactive systems.
24/O1.achieves: It provides the learner with the human-centered design and usability foundation needed to evaluate and design XR systems from the user's perspective.

24/O2.goal: Explain how XR systems function as interactive systems and why their input interaction design and output perception design require user-centered design.
24/O2.achieves: It lets the learner connect general interactive-system principles to XR hardware and software, supporting the course aim of understanding and implementing XR systems with confidence.
